title: Ping Remote
body:
Ping Remote

Ever worried about your server working at home/behind firewall? Meet Ping Remote! This simple mod allows yor server to ping remote hosts with configurable tick period. ## Use case * Your server is running at home behind closed firewall/in data-center behind WAF * You want to know if server is running, but you are too lazy to setup prometheus or other overengineering stuff * You still want to monitor status of your server Install this mod, launch server once, update the config, and you are ready to go! ## Config example (ping every 20 server ticks) ```json { "remoteHost": "https://example.com", "tickAmount": 20, "debug": false } ``` ## Credits * Project icon by [Flaticon](https://www.flaticon.com/free-icon/ping-pong_907477)
